name: Splitbeam
summary: Write one post and a glass prism splits it into coloured beams, one for each channel you picked
about: A cross-posting composer for a small shop. Pick any of six channels, each with its own colour and rules: Short posts counts against 280 characters, and Photo feed and Video page need a cover image. Press Publish: a white beam drops into a glass prism, which fans it out into a coloured beam per channel; each tile fills its own bar, goes Live with a tick and a burst of light, and channels that cannot take the post shake and are skipped.
how: Write your post; the counter and the Short posts tile show how close you are to 280 characters.
Tap channel tiles to switch them on or off; each one says Ready, Over by, or Needs a cover.
Add cover attaches a cover picture so the photo and video channels can post too.
Press Publish: the beam splits in the prism and travels to every ready channel, which posts and goes Live.
A summary lists where it went live and what was skipped, then the tiles reset for the next post.
